name: EPIC 211381120
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 15.7 solar radii and 0.84 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,847 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.84 solar masses and 15.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,447 K at its surface.
